theorem extractedOldExprInVars :

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  suffices h : (mulLinearMap.comp (mulLinearMap.flip c)).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp ((mulLinearMap c).comp timeOrderF)) from
    congrArg (fun k => k a b) h
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro l r
  dsimp
  simp only [mulLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  have hs := fun x y => insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l [x, y] r
  conv at hs =>
    intro x y h
    lhs
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 2
    simp [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm, ← smul_sub]
    simp (disch := simp [hφψ, hψφ]) only [crAnTimeOrderList, hs,
      ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one]
    arg 2
    repeat rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← sub_mul]
    repeat rw [← mul_smul_comm, ← mul_sub]
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l r]
  simp only [c, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, map_smul,
    Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
  simp only [mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, crAnTimeOrderSign]
  by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ
  · rw [Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm]
  · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  any_goals solve_by_elim
  case' app l _ _ _ => have := l.canonical_form_abs
  case' tapp d _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_tabs
  case' case d _ _ _ _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_sum
  all_goals repeat' first | simp_all only [body_let, body_case, true_implies] | casesm* And .., Or .., Exists .., Value (.inl _), Value (.inr _) | cases lc
  any_goals left; constructor; assumption
  all_goals right; solve_by_elim only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ (2+1) A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable nofun
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hBs := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c) hJd x i
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t) k
  have hJs := LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (c := 𝓕.c) hJd t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA3.of_succ _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hBs.const_mul _).differentiableAt
    (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt, fderiv_const_mul hBs.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [← Time.deriv_eq, Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA3 _), time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ]
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq, div_eq_inv_mul] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_fun] at hEd
  simp (disch := solve_by_elim [Differentiable.differentiableAt]) only [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_fun_sum,
    fderiv_const_mul, _root_.sub_apply, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hg ⊢
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq, Space.deriv_commute (v := i) _
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t), Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hg ⊢
  rw [hg]
  simp [FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard) '' Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  dsimp only at hg
  have hb := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)))
  simp only [fiberwiseDistance, ← hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.sub_add_comm (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at hb
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.1 g.2) bot_le).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ?_).trans_lt hb))
  conv_rhs => rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']; rhs; rw [← Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.card_product]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber _ _ _ _ (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨⟨_, _⟩, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point _ _ i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ (2+1) A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable nofun
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hBs := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c) hJd x i
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t) k
  have hJs := LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (c := 𝓕.c) hJd t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA3.of_succ _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hBs.const_mul _).differentiableAt
    (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt, fderiv_const_mul hBs.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq, Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA3 _), time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ]
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq, div_eq_inv_mul] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_fun] at hEd
  simp (disch := solve_by_elim only [hEd, hJs, Differentiable.differentiableAt]) only [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_fun_sum,
    fderiv_const_mul, _root_.sub_apply, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hg ⊢
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq, Space.deriv_commute (v := i) _
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t), Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hg ⊢
  rw [hg]
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_inv_rev, div_eq_mul_inv]
  simp only [mul_right_comm (𝓕.μ₀⁻¹) (𝓕.ε₀⁻¹) 𝓕.μ₀, inv_mul_cancel₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]
  ring

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard) '' Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  dsimp only at hg
  have hb := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)))
  simp only [fiberwiseDistance, ← hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.sub_add_comm (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at hb
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f _ g.2) bot_le).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ?_).trans_lt hb))
  conv_rhs => rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']; rhs; rw [← Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.card_product]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber _ _ _ _ (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨⟨_, _⟩, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point _ _ i _ h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩

theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  have : Nonempty F := Zero.instNonempty
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_
  · intro u hp
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation, Nat.cast_one,
      ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    rw [← show finMapTwoWords _ _ = u from List.ofFn_injective rfl]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
    rwa [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt' ?_ (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_)
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨_, hr⟩
    · simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
      rwa [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
